notes: Added API/UI integration and test coverage stories to complete facade feature.

stories.title: Expose EvaluateCare Facade via Tool Router
stories.description: Integrate evaluate_care_facade methods into the tool_router allowlist, enabling agent-driven invocation for clinical trials search and provider detail flows with validated inputs and structured outputs.

stories.title: Integrate Facade Responses into Chat UX Rendering
stories.description: Ensure responses produced by evaluate_care_facade are correctly formatted for chat consumption, including markdown-safe links, structured sections for trials and provider details, and compatibility with MessageBubble rendering.

stories.title: Unit Tests for EvaluateCare Facade Orchestration
stories.description: Create unit tests covering evaluate_care_facade orchestration logic, including successful flows, partial failures, and edge cases for both clinical trials and provider detail paths.

stories.title: Integration Tests for End-to-End EvaluateCare Flow
stories.description: Implement integration tests validating end-to-end flow from tool invocation through facade orchestration to domain services and final response, ensuring compatibility with agent tool-use loop and external APIs.
